item.title: A Toothless Iran? Missile and Drone Strikes Show It Can Still Inflict Pain.
item.summary: A wave of strikes across the Middle East in recent days shows that Iran has not lost the capacity to retaliate.

item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Israel Vows to Seize More Territory in Lebanon, and Strikes Hit Iranian Port
item.summary: Israel said it launched a wave of strikes targeting infrastructure in Tehran and other areas, and Iran retaliated. The speaker of Iran’s parliament accused the Trump administration of engaging in a front of diplomacy while “secretly planning a ground invasion.”

item.title: Ukraine Finalizes Air Defense Deals With Gulf Nations Amid War in Mideast
item.summary: The Ukrainian president visited the Middle East, where he sought to shift his country from a recipient of military aid to a supplier.

item.title: Can This Russian Bakery Survive a 3,500% Tax Increase?
item.summary: The challenges faced by a small-business owner near Moscow highlight how Russia’s war-drained economy is on the doorstep of a major crisis.

item.title: UAE and Qatar Arrest Hundreds Over Online Videos of Iranian Attacks
item.summary: The authorities have made a wave of arrests to stop people posting footage of strikes, citing security risks. Experts also see a fear of damage to the countries’ image as safe havens.

item.title: Catholic Leaders Barred From Jerusalem Holy Site on Palm Sunday
item.summary: Israeli police stopped clergymen from celebrating the Palm Sunday Mass at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre “for the first time in centuries,” church officials said.

item.title: Iran War Draws Attention to U.S. Troop Presence in Saudi Arabia
item.summary: A close U.S. ally and regional rival of Iran, the kingdom has faced hundreds of Iranian missile and drone attacks since the war began.

item.title: Israel’s military posted two images of Ali Choeib in what it said was a Hezbollah uniform. One was fake.
Regional officials meet in Pakistan to discuss the war in Iran.
Hundreds Gather for Funeral of 3 Lebanese Killed in Israeli Strike
item.summary: Israel said one of those killed was a member of Hezbollah’s military wing “disguised as a journalist.” Lebanon’s president said all three were journalists and condemned the killings.
